techniques.name: Flipped Classroom
techniques.description: A teaching model where students learn new content at home through videos or readings and engage in interactive activities in class to deepen understanding.
tasks: Assign pre-class work for students to complete at home.
Design in-class activities that build on that knowledge.
Facilitate discussions, problem-solving, and hands-on practice.

techniques.name: Project-Based Learning
techniques.description: An instructional approach where students learn by actively engaging in real-world and personally meaningful projects. It promotes critical thinking, collaboration, and creativity.
tasks: Develop projects that align with curriculum goals.
Provide students with clear guidelines and milestones.
Facilitate opportunities for reflection and presentation.

techniques.name: Independent Study
techniques.description: Allowing students to explore topics of interest independently, fostering autonomy and self-directed learning. It encourages responsibility and personal growth.
tasks: Provide resources and guidance for independent study projects.
Support students in setting and achieving their own learning goals.

techniques.name: Peer Teaching
techniques.description: A method where students teach each other, reinforcing their own understanding and building communication skills. It can involve tutoring, group work, or presentations.
tasks: Organize activities where students explain concepts to their peers.

techniques.name: Inquiry-Based Learning
techniques.description: An approach where students learn by asking questions, investigating solutions, and constructing new understandings. It promotes curiosity and critical thinking.
tasks: Provide opportunities for exploration and research.
Guide students in developing their own questions and investigations.
